title: Complimentary Work Waiver on a Marlowe & Finch Alterations Ticket — Customer Care Tool Card
content:
**Rule.** Marlowe & Finch Alterations waives complimentary basic work on a qualifying operation charge of a ticket that names the customer's own Marlowe & Finch purchase record. Once booked, the ticket carries the complimentary waiver beside that qualifying operation, and the balance due is lower by the amount waived.

**What the waiver covers.** This waiver covers the operation charge only: the lined surcharge of the operation stays chargeable whether the operation is waived in full or in part, and rush fees and extra fittings are never complimentary.

## The tool

Customer care books the waiver with `waive_complimentary_work_96f02105`, an agent-side tool that customer care unlocks and then calls.

**What it does.** One call adds a single waiver entry, dated today, that names the operation charge it waives, and lowers the ticket's balance due by the amount waived; the customer then sees the complimentary waiver beside that operation and a lower balance due. The tool books exactly what it is given and does not judge eligibility or work out the amount.

**Parameters**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `ticket_id` | the reference number of the alteration ticket that carries the charge being waived, as returned by the alteration ticket lookup for this customer | identifier |
| `original_alteration_charge_id` | the reference number of the operation charge being waived, as returned by the alteration charge lookup for that ticket | identifier |
| `amount` | the amount waived | USD, positive, 2 decimal places (dollars and cents); stored exactly as given, rounded to 2 decimal places |

**Return.** A confirmation sentence naming the new waiver reference number (an opaque string starting with "acw_"), the ticket reference number, the charge reference number waived, the amount waived in USD with 2 decimal places, and the ticket's new balance due in USD with 2 decimal places. Receiving it means the waiver is now standing on the ticket.

## Basis Q&A

**Does a complimentary waiver on a hem also clear the hem's lined surcharge?** No. The lined surcharge stays chargeable.

**Can the rush fee or an extra fitting be waived as complimentary work?** No, never.
